cover.bottom: IN THE PATH OF RAIN, WIND AND COASTAL FLOODING

photo.query: Wikimedia Commons coastal flooding seawall Atlantic Ocean storm
photo.prompt: storm waves crashing over a seawall on the East Coast with flooded streets and dark Atlantic clouds

slides.headline: A nor'easter is battering the East Coast
slides.body: The storm is bringing rain, wind and coastal flooding this weekend, with gusts forecast up to 60 mph and breaking waves up to 9 feet.

photo.query: Wikimedia Commons nor'easter coastal flooding East Coast
photo.prompt: coastal flooding on an East Coast street during a nor'easter with rain, wind and gray skies

slides.headline: That put New York and New Jersey under emergencies
slides.body: New York and New Jersey declared states of emergency and told people to avoid travel through the weekend.

photo.query: Wikimedia Commons New Jersey coastal storm flooding street
photo.prompt: rainy flooded street near the New Jersey shore with emergency vehicles in the distance

slides.headline: And Atlantic City flooding hit its highest point since Sandy
slides.body: Flooding in Atlantic City reached its highest point since Superstorm Sandy, and neighborhoods along the Jersey Shore flooded.

photo.query: Wikimedia Commons Atlantic City flooding storm
photo.prompt: flooded Atlantic City street near the shore during a coastal storm

slides.headline: That sent rescuers to flooded New Jersey motels
slides.body: First responders rescued 9 adults and 1 dog from flooded motels in New Jersey on Saturday morning.

photo.query: Wikimedia Commons New Jersey flood rescue motel
photo.prompt: first responders near flooded motel parking lots in coastal New Jersey during heavy rain

slides.headline: And tens of thousands lost power across the region
slides.body: Tens of thousands of people in the Northeast and Mid-Atlantic lost power, and trees came down in New York City.

photo.query: Wikimedia Commons downed trees New York City storm
photo.prompt: downed trees on a New York City street after a windstorm with wet pavement and cloudy skies

slides.headline: So Saturday night into Sunday brings more flood risk
slides.body: The National Weather Service said the storm would intensify again Saturday night into Sunday, with more flooding likely.

photo.query: Wikimedia Commons storm clouds Atlantic Ocean coast
photo.prompt: dark storm clouds over the Atlantic Ocean near an East Coast shoreline
